title: Agent Factory improvement-axes policy
description: docs/FACTORY_CONTINUITY.md sec4, ADR-0016 sec7: the named, bounded, human-controlled content for the idle ladder's never-idle rung. Versioned and human-edited -- live on/off state lives separately in .gc/runtime/factory-improvement-axes-state.json, mirroring config/provider-policy.json vs .gc/provider-state.json.

maintain_alive_default.description: Default of the master switch: when true (the required default per ADR-0016 sec7), an empty release-target queue draws from an enabled axis instead of idling. When false, the campaign goes idle and the cockpit says so plainly.

scope_boundary.description: What this axis may and may not touch. Enforced narratively by the wake message, not mechanically -- the mechanical guarantee is draft_only for any axis whose boundary is itself a reserved-class decision (ADR-0015 sec3 / ADR-0016 sec8).

draft_only.description: True for an axis whose scope boundary touches a reserved-class decision. A draft_only axis must never dispatch executable work; it only ever produces a human-reviewable proposal bead.

ref.description: Where the mechanism lives, e.g. 'skill:code-review' or 'doc:docs/products/saymyname/DESIGN_GOVERNANCE.md'. Required when status is 'wired'.
